recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core FHIR source work is needed for FHIR-11207 unless Patient Care later reopens broader AllergyIntolerance status guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-11207 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care clarification for AllergyIntolerance from DSTU2. It asked to replace wording that said allergies with status entered-in-error were inactive allergies with wording that says the allergy or intolerance statement was entered by mistake and is invalid.
initial_application: Commit e7c9c0d32a1b91ac406c98fd0a2441fec2c625fb explicitly mentioned #11207 and replaced the old inactive-allergies sentence in source/allergyintolerance/allergyintolerance-notes.xml with entered-by-mistake/invalid wording. Commit ed170ff0754268f2a677a011f9d432d1328415f0 later updated that note to use verificationStatus after the clinical/workflow status split, and commit fd29fa2cbf5790eb72afa4ee2027327b4af2e397 only corrected grammar.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists allergyintolerance=AllergyIntolerance, so the checked AllergyIntolerance source is in current build scope. The current StructureDefinition identifies the entered-in-error status as AllergyIntolerance.verificationStatus, says clinicalStatus should be present only when verificationStatus is not entered-in-error and the code is not negated, and marks verificationStatus as the modifier for refuted/entered-in-error validity. Related Published issues FHIR-11206 and FHIR-11151 support the same separation of inactive clinical status from entered-in-error verification status.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because no source change is needed. The obsolete inactive-allergies wording is absent from build-scope AllergyIntolerance source, and current source communicates the requested semantics without redundant prose.
